description: This file contains TypeScript code for loading and parsing tsconfig files, including handling of extends, references, and options like allowJs and paths.

methods.name: loadTsConfig
methods.description: Loads a tsconfig file and its references, returning an array of LoadedTsConfig objects.

methods.name: resolveConfigFile
methods.description: Resolves the path to a referenced tsconfig file, appending .json if necessary and handling node_modules fallback.

methods.name: innerLoadTsConfig
methods.description: Recursively loads a tsconfig file, handling extends, references, and options, with caching to prevent cycles.

methods.name: StripBom
methods.description: Removes BOM characters from a string if present.
